title: Search component facets
description: Return Role and Property options with conditional counts, excluding the selected filter of each facet. No pagination or sorting.

name.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of an all-language preferred/alternative name or GMO ID. Empty means no search filter.

role_id.description: Role GMO ID, including all descendant Roles. Empty means no Role filter. Role facet counts ignore this parameter. none selects components without any assignment of the classification predicate, independent of labels.

property_id.description: Directly assigned Property GMO ID. Empty means no Property filter. Property facet counts ignore this parameter. none selects components without any assignment of the classification predicate, independent of labels.
